entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • EmailAddressAttribute isn't validating properly #129393
  • JIT: STRESS_OPT_REPEAT silent miscompile produces wrong-direction branch into divide-by-zero #129386
  • [ci-scan] Hang: System.Collections.Tests on osx.15.amd64.open #129385
  • [ci-scan] Hang: cDAC dump generation on Windows.11.Arm64.Open #129384
  • [ci-scan-feedback] Strengthen recently-closed KBE dedup and block JIT/GC workarounds #129381

Closed

  • Assert ((size_t)g_gc_lowest_address - ps) >= OS_PAGE_SIZE #79308
    Future
  • Assertion failed 'lclVarType != TYP_UNDEF' during 'Lowering nodeinfo' #65674
    Future
  • [browser][CoreCLR] `GlobalizationNative_*` P/Invokes are not trimmed under InvariantGlobalization #129242
    Future
  • JIT: stale ZF after rotate causes wrong-direction branch in if (BitOperations.RotateRight(x, n) == 0) pattern #129288
    11.0.0
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: System.Security.Cryptography.Tests segfault on linux-arm under libraries-jitstress #129378
  • Wasm / R2R: struct-returning instance method via field reference asserts in dispatch helper #129347

PullRequests

Created

  • [ARM32] Eliminate red zone usage in runtime stubs #129398
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • JIT: unpin locals whose value is provably non-movable #129397
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [browser] upgrade wasm exceptions #129396
    arch-wasm, area-Build-mono, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Suppress wake-up preemption on Linux in LowLevelLifoSemaphore (parallel to Windows SetThreadPriorityBoost) #129395
    area-System.Threading
  • Fix OpenSSL X509Chain time validity depending on process time zone #129394
    area-System.Security, community-contribution
  • JIT: recognize CORINFO_HELP_BOX in impThrowIfNull #129392
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Wasm R2R: implement support for resume after catch #129391
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Improve RangeOps::Merge #129390
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [interp] Send CreateThread debugger event from the interpreter #129389
    os-ios, area-CodeGen-Interpreter-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • JIT: support TYP_LONG induction variables in loop analysis and cloning #129388
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • JIT: fold `CAST<small>(COMMA(se, IND<small-same-size>))` #129387
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Add UsePureLLVMToolchain for compiler-rt+lld combo #129382
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • add tracing configuration #129380
    area-System.Diagnostics.Tracing
  • Enable System.Net.Http and System.Net.Security on OpenBSD #129379
    area-System.Net.Security, community-contribution
  • Add missing fast path for DateTime format "G" #129374
    area-System.DateTime

Merged

  • [browser][wasm] Prep changes ahead of emsdk bump #129383
    arch-wasm, area-Build-mono, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [browser][coreCLR] link out icu/globalization module on InvariantGlobalization flag #129336
    arch-wasm, area-System.Globalization, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • JIT: don't claim rotates set ZF on xarch #129348
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [cdac] Pipeline refactor + StackWalk doc cleanup + DataGenerator build fix #129244
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • [browser][coreCLR] set "LANG" env variable #129221
    arch-wasm, area-System.Globalization, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Wasm R2R: push this before retbuf in InterpToR2R thunk args #129356
    area-crossgen2-coreclr

Updated

  • Track return type for shared generics via exact context #129373
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • JIT: Switch to rangecheck when profitable #128524
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
  • Upgrade emsdk to 5.0.6 #129299
    arch-wasm, area-codeflow, os-browser
  • Arm64: [PAC-RET] NativeAOT changes #128950
    community-contribution, area-NativeAOT-coreclr
  • Fix segfault in GC standalone large pages emulation mode (segments path) #127763

  • JIT: extend OptimizeConstCompare to remove TYP_BYTE casts #129361
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [Wasm RyuJIT] Spill live ref/byref values to pinned stack slots at calls #129059
    arch-wasm, area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • Fix NoopLimiter disposal in DefaultPartitionedRateLimiter Heartbeat #127582
    area-System.Threading
  • [mobile] .NET 11 mobile runtime configuration updates #129293
    area-Infrastructure-mono, 11.0.0
  • [clr-ios] Preserve inherited MemberData statics on maccatalyst CoreCLR #128409

  • [clr-ios] Disable failing tests and fix trimming in Apple CoreCLR mobile test suites #129226
    area-Infrastructure, linkable-framework, os-ios, 11.0.0

    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, 11.0.0
  • JIT: remove getUnboxedEntry and getInstantiatedEntry #129285
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, community-contribution
